title: Primordial Gravitational Waves (B-mode Polarization)
bottleneck: Inflation generically predicts a stochastic gravitational-wave background imprinting B-mode polarization on the CMB, but only upper limits exist (r < 0.036). Foreground dust complexity nearly derailed the field after BICEP2, and reaching r ~ 0.001 requires controlling systematics and foregrounds at unprecedented levels. Galactic dust foregrounds are complex and frequency-dependent, requiring multi-band observations to separate from a primordial signal.
why_it_blocks: A B-mode detection would be the first direct evidence of quantum gravity effects and pin down inflation's energy scale; continued nulls progressively kill large-field models without confirming alternatives.
current_state: BICEP/Keck, Simons Observatory, and CMB-S4 are the staged path forward; LiteBIRD targets a space-based measurement late this decade. Delensing using high-resolution CMB maps will be essential to reach the faintest tensor amplitudes.

sources.title: DESI 2024 VI: Cosmological Constraints from BAO Measurements
